name: Media Organizer 1.5.1
body:
**New option: uncertain dates.** When no real capture date can be found (no EXIF, no video metadata, no filename date), the app previously guessed from the file's modified date and sorted the file by it. Now you choose in Advanced options:
- **Set them aside in an '_uncertain' folder (default)** — guesses never get misfiled into wrong dates
- Use the file date anyway

Also fixes folder names showing in lowercase in the plan table on some systems.

179 automated tests + 131 QA scenario checks, all passing.

Download **MediaOrganizer-Setup-1.5.1.exe** below.
